units.source_text: 两个孩子分骑两匹带马嚼子的无鞍马，并驾齐驱地绕着圆圈奔跑。

en.t: Two children rode separately on two unsaddled horses with bits in their mouths, running side by side around the ring.

units.source_text: 阿光在这两个孩子的后面，双脚分立在两匹马上，做了一个站立的姿势，

en.t: Behind the two children, A Guang stood with one foot on each horse, striking a standing pose,

units.source_text: 然后将上身向前微弓，蹲了下来，用脚后跟策马飞奔。

en.t: then bent her upper body slightly forward, crouched down, and urged the horses into a gallop with her heels.

units.source_text: 阿光的身体同马儿的步伐保持平衡，让两个孩子站在马背上，

en.t: Keeping her body balanced with the horses' stride, A Guang had the two children stand on the horses' backs,

units.source_text: 她抓住两人的腰带，把他们举起，让他们面对面地骑在自己的双肩上。

en.t: then seized them by their sashes, lifted them up, and set them facing each other astride her shoulders.

units.source_text: 然后，她进一步看准时机，加强握力，用劲伸展双臂，

en.t: Then, watching for the right moment, she tightened her grip and stretched both arms out with all her strength,

units.source_text: 让两个孩子在自己的双肩上站起来。

en.t: making the two children rise to their feet on her shoulders.

units.source_text: 孩子们互相握住对方的一只手，在阿光的肩上挺立，

en.t: The children clasped one of each other's hands and stood upright on A Guang's shoulders,

units.source_text: 借助阿光的胳膊，右肩上的孩子伸出右手右腿，

en.t: and with the help of A Guang's arms, the child on her right shoulder extended a right arm and right leg,

units.source_text: 左肩上的孩子伸出左手左腿，展示了一个平衡动作。

en.t: while the child on her left shoulder extended a left arm and left leg, displaying a balancing feat.
A burst of applause rose from the audience.

units.source_text: 马背上的三个人保持着这种平衡的姿势，在热烈的掌声中，绕场一两周……

en.t: The three figures on horseback kept this balanced pose and circled the arena once or twice amid enthusiastic applause...

units.source_text: 之后，孩子们一下子从阿光的肩头跳到马背上。

en.t: After that, the children suddenly leapt from A Guang's shoulders back onto the horses' backs.

units.source_text: 刚表演完这个杂技动作，连歇也没歇息，

en.t: No sooner had she finished performing this acrobatic feat, without even taking a rest,

units.source_text: 阿光为了招徕观众，又得骑着马儿到帐篷外面展示这马上的技艺。

en.t: than A Guang had to ride the horse outside the tent again to show off the horseback skill and draw in spectators.
